svg.title: agentic-wave, the whole workflow
svg.desc: One planner that never touches the code, a swarm of guarded coders, and a machine verdict at every step.
svg.text: One planner that never touches the code, a swarm of guarded coders, and a machine verdict at every step.
SCENARIO 1/2 · A LOT, START TO FINISH
01/12 The operator states the idea and is grilled until it is clear.
02/12 The planner cuts the idea into lots and picks a cycle.
03/12 wave lot start: the size decides the regime and asks for a spec.
04/12 Anchored briefs, each with its own perimeter.
05/12 The lot admits the slice: no overlap, under the cap.
06/12 A cheaper model codes, inside its perimeter, every call judged.
07/12 The gate runs the command and checks the perimeter: PASS.
08/12 Fresh agents review; the planner never grades its own work.
09/12 Integrated only with a finished review.
10/12 The operator runs it for real, marks it, and opens the PR.
11/12 Marks, CI and a whole-lot gate, in that order: closed.
12/12 Merged with a merge commit. Next lot.
02/06 The agent finishes a first attempt.
03/06 FAIL: the command is red or the perimeter was breached.
04/06 One repair round, with the verdict pasted in.
